assumptions: No hf tokenizer is reachable (transformers not installed; model files only on the serving pod), so prompt size was estimated from chars. The first 194 rows used a 0.267 chars->tokens ratio; a -128-token error on live turn 1 replaced it with the calibrated regression (slope 0.26893, intercept -219.1, median |residual| 81.9 over 5,370 workspace prompts). The trigger always used the server's own prompt_tokens for the prefix, so only the appended delta was estimated; at triggers the error was median -7 tokens.

Read 'budgets 32768 and 65536, turns ~150/~300, request cap 1200 total' as bounding one unit, not the whole run: 8 arms x 150 turns already exceeds 1,200 rows, so the live tree was completed as four appending units (32k 8 arms x 160; 64k 8 arms x 150-190) with 2,780 live requests total.
Budget 2 uses 190 turns rather than ~300 (300 x 8 = 2,400 rows before the cap); the 64k boundary is crossed once at turn 143, which satisfies the gate and supports the matched-turn contrast.

S-k800/F-k800 and the pointer renderer run at 64k only: the 32k tree had already consumed the request cap, and each compacting arm keeps its matched baseline (B for append-note, B-ptr for pointer) at its budget.
keep_last is interpreted in TOKENS (800/1600) rather than nodes -- G3's keep_last=2 over ~1,187-token turns folded ~2,400 tokens and never fired.

Statistical unit is the turn; bootstrap over turns (10,000 resamples, seed 20251023) because per-turn uncached counts are skewed and within-arm turns are not independent. The matched-turn contrast compares each cooperating arm with its baseline on the SAME turn to remove the baseline's own phase drift (32k B-ptr: 733 mean uncached in its first 50 turns vs 1,247 after).
next_unit_hint: Publish the bounded cost: compaction is not cache-free (+68 to +324 uncached tok/turn at 32k, +90 to +188 at 64k, every CI excluding zero) and the fork's marker is the expensive part (append-note +324 vs pointer +68 at 32k). The 32k B-ptr baseline carries a phase artefact (two very low-uncached turns in one unit) that inflates its arm mean and is already handled by the matched-turn contrast; a short replication with the same calibration on a fresh 32k tree (8 arms x 160 turns, one unit) would pin the 32k absolute means. A ~300-turn 64k run needs its own unit and a request cap above 2,400.
